description: Found by the fz-kdt.198 refutation (2026-09-03), pre-existing at accb5cfbe: Types::is_disjoint (compiler2/types/mod.rs, trait decl src/types/mod.rs, SharedTypes forward) and differs_only_nominally have zero production callers -- only types_test.rs asserts and each other. The only live disjointness is is_value_disjoint via native_codegen/type_pred.rs (brand-blind, fz-bsx), whose doc comment names is_disjoint as "the fz-bsx bug". The set-theoretic-types.md predicate table no longer claims argument checks use it (198 corrected that row). Either delete the surface with its tests restated on is_empty(intersect) / is_subtype, or name the consumer that needs a brand-AWARE disjointness (fz-kdt.127.2 / fz-kdt.169 key erasure is the only candidate). Not 198: not superseded by the refinement encoding.
title: Types::is_disjoint and differs_only_nominally have no production caller: delete the brand-aware disjointness surface or give it a real user
